COPYRIGHT RULES, 1967
COPYRIGHT RULES, 1967
(Substitution of Second Sched.)
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
6th June, 2011]
S.R.O. 580(I)/2011 dated 4-6-2011.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by subsection (1) of section 82 of the Copyright Ordinance, 1962
(XXXIV of 1962), the Federal Government is pleased to direct that the following
amendments in the Copyright Rules, 1967 shall be made, which were, as required
by the said subsection, previously published vide its Notification No. S.R.O.
183(I)/2011, dated the 7th March, 2011, namely:--
In the aforesaid rules, for the Second Schedule the following
shall be substituted, namely:
